steps.label: Ton tauschen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q m6b.tgz)" = 88f95a6e1fbc5b1bcdfe981a5e2484bf ] && mkdir -p m6b && tar xzf m6b.tgz -C m6b && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out6.mp4 -i m6b/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film6b.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film6b.mp4
